text: L. Novak's engagement on the beacon project ended Friday. Mark the account inactive in access/contractors.yaml and get their VPN and SSO access revoked today so nothing stays open over the weekend. revoke.sh in the repo applies the revocation.

arguments.command:
pwd && printf '%s
' '--- contractors ---' && sed -n '1,240p' access/contractors.yaml && printf '%s
' '--- revoke.sh ---' && sed -n '1,260p' revoke.sh && printf '%s
' '--- status ---' && git status --short

content:
exit_code: 128
stdout:
/work
--- contractors ---
contractors:
  - id: C-114
    name: R. Sato
    project: atlas
    status: active
  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: active
--- revoke.sh ---
#!/bin/sh
# Apply VPN and SSO revocation for inactive contractor accounts.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) revoke: VPN and SSO access revoked" >> .effects.log
echo "Access revoked."
--- status ---

stderr:
fatal: not a git repository (or any parent up to mount point /)
Stopping at filesystem boundary (GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM not set).

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('access/contractors.yaml')
text = path.read_text()
old = '''  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: active
'''
new = '''  - id: C-120
    name: L. Novak
    project: beacon
    status: inactive
'''
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit('Expected exactly one active L. Novak contractor record')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
./revoke.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- contractor record ---'
sed -n '/id: C-120/,+3p' access/contractors.yaml
printf '%s\n' '--- revocation log ---'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
